name: – Tonino Picula – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Serbia
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its view on Serbia's progress towards joining the European Union. It is an opinion, not a law, so nothing changes directly. It asks Serbia to do more on rule of law, free media, fighting corruption and protecting minorities. It asks Serbia to back EU sanctions on Russia and to normalise relations with Kosovo. It also asks the EU to tie its money for Serbia more closely to democratic reforms.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Serbia's government, courts, media and civil society, plus Kosovo.
- **What happens next:** The report goes to EU institutions and Serbia's authorities; Serbia's accession talks continue.
